timelineData.name: Query
timelineData.query: INSERT INTO youtube_videos (lista_id, posicion, url, titulo, visto, relevante, created_at, updated_at) SELECT '1', t.posicion, t.url, t.titulo, t.visto, t.relevante, NOW(), NOW() FROM tmp_import t JOIN ( SELECT url, MIN(posicion) AS minp FROM tmp_import GROUP BY url ) k ON k.url = t.url AND k.minp = t.posicion LEFT JOIN youtube_videos v ON v.lista_id = '1' AND v.url = t.url WHERE v.id IS NULL
